title: aulacocalyx divergens
intro: Aulacocalyx divergens, commonly known as African bush willow, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aulacocalyx divergens include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
